description: For the map \(f:\{0,1,2\}\to\{p,q,r\}\) with \(f(0)=p\) and \(f(1)=f(2)=q\), equality of outputs relates \(a,b\) exactly when both are zero or both belong to \(\{1,2\}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.finite_relation_iff (a b : Fin 3) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.finiteSetoid a b ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∨ a ∈ {1, 2} ∧ b ∈ {1, 2}
